tasks.title: Visitors can subscribe, confirm and unsubscribe through safe accessible forms
tasks.spec: ## Repository: status, entire section: R2, R6, status parts of R7, D9-D10, D-R3/D-R4; Status routes and Feature off counterexamples; Checks and Completion evidence; Performance impact and applicable Security impact. Keep settings, the contract pin and served module graph, client, route dispatch, page templates/styles, HTTP tests and accessibility tests together so the feature is usable and default-off behavior stays green at the only task boundary. Pin the merged contract child's full SHA; add every module imported by its index to contractModules, including the already-merged #806 modules (runtime-settings.js, notify-channels.js, resend.js and validate-runtime.js) as well as subscriptions.js and validate-subscriptions.js. Read the bearer secret once and require PUBLIC_URL when enabled. Implement every R2 route, check order, literal response text, no-JS form and origin rule, with 2048-byte form bodies and 4096-byte notify answers. Use requestJson with the configured timeout, wire validation and no redirects. Preserve metrics by status code, privacy-safe failure logs, no-store result pages, headers and form-action self only when enabled; never echo an address. Apply R7's sole Token exception consistently: only the 200 GET/HEAD representation of /subscribe/confirm or /unsubscribe contains that same request's pattern-checked query token exactly once, escaped in its hidden token field, with no-store and no-referrer. No invalid-link page, POST result, root page, notify answer, log or metric may echo a token. Keep the subscribe section after Maintenance outside poller updates. Record the starting-main SHA before measurements. Read shared findings first and report any wire gap for the notify child.

acceptance.expected: 0 fail (focused coverage exit status is not the gate). Cover every Status routes counterexample and R2 mapping: foreign/null Origin and cross-site fetch return 403 with 0 notify calls; wrong content types 415, 2049 bytes 413, duplicate/extra fields and invalid addresses/tokens 400. Valid subscribe forwards exactly {"email":"sub-a@e2e.invalid"} and the test-file bearer token to /subscriptions; confirm/unsubscribe forward exactly {"token":...} to their fixed paths. Preview GET/HEAD make 0 notify calls; duplicate preview token is 400. Notify 202 maps to public 200, subscribe 429 to 429, subscribe 400 to 400, invalid/expired confirmation 404 to 400, valid confirm/unsubscribe 200 to 200, other failures to 503. A 302 reaches 0 redirect-target requests; absent wire header is tolerated and wire header 2 yields 503. Test timeout, network error and invalid answer. Result pages have no-store, form-action 'self', no-referrer and current security headers, with no submitted address or hostile <script> text. PUT /subscribe and other POST routes remain 405 with allow GET, HEAD; GET /subscribe is 404. Off: POST /subscribe 405, confirmation GET 404, 0 subscribe sections, form-action 'none'. Missing token/public URL errors name their setting; a 31-character bearer secret is refused without echo. Served contract import-graph traversal has 0 missing modules.

0 fail (focused coverage exit status is not the gate). R7 Token exception uses the literal AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA (43 A): GET /subscribe/confirm with it returns 200 and contains it exactly once inside name="token" value="..."; GET with an appended B (44 characters) returns 400 and contains neither the 43- nor 44-character token. Confirm POST results mapping notify 200, 404 and 503 contain 0 occurrences. Repeat equivalent valid/invalid/POST-result checks for the unsubscribe pattern and assert 0 tokens in root/error pages, captured failure logs and metrics. Valid link pages have no-store and no-referrer; GET and HEAD never call notify. Request text including token-bearing query strings never reaches logs. These explicit assertions are the exception to the general no-token-response rule, never an exception for addresses or notify JSON.
exit 0 for lint, both TypeScript projects and the full test suite with at least 80% line coverage. Existing status, proxy, feed, headers and metrics tests stay green.

exit 0; 0 axe violations on the subscription form and the five result pages, each at 360 and 1280 px in light/dark with and without JavaScript. Forms have accessible labels/buttons and usable keyboard/no-JS submit flows; the existing a11y scenarios still pass.

Run five times per side on the branch and its starting main in a writable scratch checkout; all suites pass. Report median user+sys CPU on both sides and B minus A. Branch median is at most 3.4 s, the independent api/bench/budgets.json status test_cpu_s budget; expected increase is up to 0.4 s.

acceptance.command: cd "$PULSE_573_API_SCRATCH" && if rg -q -- '--b-ref' bench; then bun bench/run.ts --a "$PULSE_573_API_MAIN_SHA" --b "$PULSE_573_API_MAIN_SHA" --others-ref main --b-ref "status=$PULSE_573_STATUS_SHA" --rounds 1; else printf '%s\n' 'benchmark unavailable: api main has no --b-ref'; fi
acceptance.expected: When api main supports --b-ref, the benchmark passes independent api/bench/budgets.json gates and the PR includes the table and discloses --rounds 1. Otherwise report the missing capability and explain that subscriptions are off in the bench fixture, so runtime metrics are expected unchanged. Use a writable scratch api checkout, never modify read-only context repositories.

With subscriptions enabled and a local fake notify, manually submit subscribe, open the confirm link and press Confirm subscription. Record the exact non-secret configuration, commands and returned codes: subscribe 200, preview 200 with 0 confirm operations, confirmation POST 200. Exercise once without JavaScript.

The PR records #573, the merged full contract SHA, check/a11y output, manual commands and codes, performance medians and runtime benchmark evidence or the specified fallback, and every applicable Security impact item (origin/auth order, size limits, escaping and the R7 Token exception with literal-token GET/error/POST checks, no other token or secret/address leakage, fixed upstream/no redirects and pins). Docs list R6 settings/routes and D-R3/D-R4; feature remains off by default.
